datasets.name: Bijie landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: To develop the landslide identification system, this work uses an authenticated remote sensing dataset called the Bijie landslide dataset, available at http://gpcv .whu .edu .cn /data /Bijie _pages .html.

datasets.name: TripleSat satellite imagery
datasets.verbatim: All of the imagery in this set were cropped from TripleSat satellite (https://www .satimagingcorp .com /satellite -sensors /triplesat -satellite/) images taken between May and August 2018.

methods.name: Visual saliency-based landslide identification framework
methods.summary: A deep learning framework that uses visual saliency-based feature extraction to enhance landslide segmentation. It applies super-resolution techniques to input images, computes saliency maps using band-pass filters based on the difference of bilateral (DoB) filters, and uses these saliency maps as input to a fine-tuned U-Net architecture for semantic segmentation.
methods.source: S. Sreelakshmi and S.S. Vinod Chandra
methods.verbatim: This paper proposes a deep-learning-based method for precisely and reliably identifying landslides from satellite optical images... In this paper, we have developed a U-Net architecture using Python from scratch to extend it for remote sensing image segmentation tasks.

availability.author_statement: Data will be made available on request.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input imagery are referenced and publicly accessible, but the custom code for the proposed framework is not provided or linked.
